component.name: LinBible
component.summary: Offline Bible study — a desktop port of AndBible

description.p: LinBible brings AndBible's Bible study features to the Linux desktop: Bibles, commentaries, dictionaries and general books in the SWORD format, Strong's numbers and morphology, cross references, split windows that follow each other, bookmarks with labels, notes and StudyPads, full text search, and downloading documents from the CrossWire, AndBible, eBible, STEP and other repositories.
